messages:
Maria: Quick follow-up from the Veridian private deployment postmortem. We consolidated the action items that slipped and need owners + verification cadence. Main buckets: peering instability, on-prem NAT churn, and an intermittent edge-proxy isolation bug causing 502s.

Sam: Got it. Can you drop the short action list here so I can claim ownership?

Maria: Short list: 1) Harden peering recon and add safe backoff/circuit-breaker. 2) Improve NAT mapping visibility + conntrack alerts. 3) Fix edge-proxy handshake race that isolates tenants. 4) Add recurring verification job for peering + MTU checks. 5) Add a postmortem regression test to Redwood Optimize for the edge behavior.

Kevin: I can take #3 (edge-proxy race). Sounds similar to a bug I fixed in a different service. I'll start with a lightweight repro harness.

Olivia: I can own #4 (recurring verification). I'll add a playbook and a cron job in infra-monitoring. Need to confirm checklist entries.

Sam: I'll pick #1 and #2. For retries I'll propose exp backoff with full jitter and a CB threshold. Also want an MTU probe; fragmentation was a root cause in the incident.

Maria: Thanks. Acceptance criteria I want tracked: A) peering recon rate < 2/hour for 7-day window, B) NAT mapping stale < 10s, C) isolation repro covered by unit/regression test, D) recurring job green on first 3 runs.

Kevin: Created INC-VD-5010 for the edge-proxy fix with repro steps and trace logs. I'll try a patch that pauses incoming streams until KV cache warm.

Sam: Created INC-VD-5011 for peering + NAT visibility. Draft retry config in PR: ```yaml
retry:
  policy: exponential
  base: 250ms
  cap: 20s
  jitter: full
circuit_breaker:
  failures: 6
  sliding_window: 60s
```

Olivia: Added job INC-VD-5012 to run every Tue/Fri 03:00 UTC. Checklist items: `BGP state`, `route table diff`, `handshake latency`, `MTU probe`, `NAT staleness`, `conntrack usage`. Will push first result to this thread.

IncidentBot: [automation] Job INC-VD-5012 scheduled by Olivia at 2523459000  queued.

Sam: Note: Veridian's edge appliance has a rate limit on session creation. Before we increase retries we should coordinate with their infra team @veridian-sys to avoid triggering their defenses.

Maria: Agreed. @veridian-sys can we schedule a 30m sync this week to align on retry parameters and a maintenance window to check MTU?

veridian-sys: We can do Thu 15:00 UTC. We'll have our network team join. Please send agenda.

Kevin: Timeline estimate: prototype patch by EOD, small QA run next day. Risk: introducing a small cold-start delay when we block until KV warm. I'll include telemetry.

Olivia: Job run finished: `handshake latency avg 140ms`, `MTU mismatch detected on peer A`, `NAT stale peak 9s`, `conntrack 72%`. Artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/INC-VD-5012/run-2523459200.json

Maria: That MTU mismatch lines up with the earlier root cause. Sam, can you propose safe drain+retry steps in the PR? Also add a fallback to a lower throughput mode if the peer signals rate-limiting.

Sam: Adding graceful drain API + backoff; will include fallback to single-connection mode when peer uses rate-limiter header. PR linked: https://scm.redwood/pr/VD-5011

Kevin: Patch PR for edge-proxy: https://scm.redwood/pr/VD-5010. Implemented `kv_block_on_warm` + 400ms passive delay. Local repro -> passes. Pushing for staging.

Olivia: Dashboard updated. Added alert: if handshake latency > 300ms or NAT stale > 20s trigger paging on-call.

Maria: Owner + timeline summary: Kevin -> INC-VD-5010 edge-proxy patch (QA 48h), Sam -> INC-VD-5011 peering/NAT + MTU probe (staging deploy 72h), Olivia -> INC-VD-5012 recurring checks + dashboard (prod schedule). I'll coordinate the Thu sync and block 1h on our calendars.

Sam: I'll also add an entry to the Dedicated customer handbook with recommended retry parameters for on-prem peers and a note about MTU checks.

Kevin: I'll add the regression test to Redwood Optimize evals after staging passes.

IncidentBot: [automation] Thread labeled `postmortem-followup, private-dedicated` and pinned by Maria.

Maria: Thanks all. If any blockers pop up, drop them here. We'll reconvene after the Veridian sync and the first recurring job run. :thumbsup:

Olivia: No infra blockers. I'll post the first scheduled report after Thu's sync.

Sam: Waiting on the sync and the MTU window.

Kevin: One thing to watch: the passive delay may add ~200ms to cold-starts, telemetry will be attached. Rollback plan in PR if customer sees regressions.

Maria: Noted. Closing for now  we'll reopen if the job flags anything abnormal.
